title: エリートトレーナーとの出会い

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One morning, a flyer in my mailbox catches my eye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Aquarium Grand Opening!" "Right next to the station! A tranquil space perfect for relaxation!"
choice_data_list: This might be a nice change of pace for <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't want to let this opportunity pass us by. I grab the flyer and go looking for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first place I check is the training track, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, my trainee isn't around. I decide to invite her next time I see her and turn to leave.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Whoa… Look at her go! It's like she's not even the same Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text: That special training program's doing wonders for her. She's barely even started, but it's like she's already on a whole new level.

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Look! It's Trainer Kiryuin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A crowd of people has formed nearby. I find myself following their line of sight, where I see…

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Great work, Meek. You ran really well today.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Still, you lost focus a bit at the end. If you hadn't, I think you could have gone even faster.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Try to concentrate right up until the finish line. I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer. I'll do my best… Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: That's Aoi Kiryuin… Did you know she's the heir to the Kiryuin family? They've raised more superstar runners than I can count…

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Right! She got the top score on the first-term license exam, too!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text: Happy Meek didn't use to be anything to write home about, but recently she's been making amazing progress!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems that Trainer Kiryuin and her trainee Happy Meek are the ones attracting all the attention.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah! Excuse me! Are you…?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I knew it! You're Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: That's right! I'm sorry, this must be quite sudden, but… I've always admired you!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Trainer… Who is this?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah! I'm sorry, Meek! I just ran off, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Phew… Sorry, I didn't mean to scare everyone. Let's try this again, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: It's a pleasure to meet you! My name is Aoi Kiryuin. I'm a Tracen Academy trainer, just like you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: And this is my trainee, Happy Meek. Meek, do you want to say hello?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Hello… I'm Happy Meek…

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Um, you may not be aware of this, but…

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: …You and I were actually assigned to Tracen Academy at almost the same time.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Maybe this is weird, but I've always felt closer to you because of that.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: So I really hoped I'd have the chance to speak with you someday.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Would you mind meeting up again in the future? I'm sure we can learn a lot from each other.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! It's an honor.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Um, Meek? It's rude to stare, you know.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Ah… Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite Trainer Kiryuin's words, Happy Meek keeps staring at me… or, more specifically, at something in my hand.
choice_data_list: Are you interested in this flyer?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh… Is that an aquarium flyer? Meek, have you been looking at this the whole time?
choice_data_list: Do you… want to go check it out?
Do you… want to go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Wow… The jellyfish are so wavy…

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Hehe… She's really having a great time. I never knew Meek liked aquariums so much.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: But… are you sure I should be here?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I just… Well, the Trainer's Handbook—that is, the teachings of the Kiryuin family—states that "Umamusume must be given appropriate rest."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: It also says the trainer is supposed to leave the Umamusume to her own devices during rest periods. That way she can truly relax.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: So is it all right for me to accompany her? I wouldn't be causing her stress, would I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Trainer Kiryuin—ever the serious type—is worried about neglecting her family's teachings. However…

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Ah…! This starfish looks just like my trainer…

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: …I'll tell her later… Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I look at Happy Meek…
choice_data_list: I think she's happy you're here.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Really? Do you think so?
choice_data_list: It's important to get to know your trainee.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Get to know her, huh…

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I didn't even realize she liked aquariums until today.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Maybe… I still don't really understand her at all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After enjoying the aquarium with Trainer Kiryuin, we all return to the academy and see Happy Meek back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Not only did you invite me on a wonderful day out, you also taught me an important lesson.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yes. Learning all you can about your trainee is practically point one of the Trainer's Handbook.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I always thought that meant having a good grasp of their physical capabilities.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: But thanks to our conversation, I feel like now I understand what it really means.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. No need to be so humble.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I think I understand why you caught the director's attention now.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: You sincerely care about your trainee—not just as a racer, but as an individual. That's where you really shine as a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll just have to work harder. I can't have you leaving me behind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Trainer Kiryuin and I make our way back to the trainer dorm, talking about training theory all the way.
